title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1521: Nine transformations (2)

section.p: Seeing that nobody else was saying anything, Great Qin King said, “You may proceed. Longwu, Qin Zhen, use your skylotus petals as well. Try to recover as much as possible. Use the carrier treasures you received from Su Yu and recover your bodies.”
He looked at Yellow Nine, paused slightly, and said, “You are probably a Liu. I can sense a familiar presence in your bloodline. Do you wish to return to Liu City?”

Yellow Nine bowed and said, “Thank you for the offer, but no. I wish to stay with my elder. I might have a human body, but I have the heart of a spatial beast. I know the human Invincibles wish to do something for me, but there is no need for that. I have grown up happily. Elder has been kind to me. If you really want to do something, save it for the others from the Liu Family. As for me…I only hope that you can keep this a secret from Liu Wenyan. There is no need to add on to the grief he is feeling.”

She looked at Hollow and smiled, “In any case, Su Yu has been worrying that I would create trouble for the Liu Family after returning. There is no need for that. If my elder can finish his dao affirmation here, consider the debt Liu Family and humanity owe me cleared. If a day comes when the human race and the spatial beast race become enemies, do as you see fit. There is no need to pull your punches because of me.”

Hollow was not touched by her words. Instead, he berated her, “What bullshit are you saying, Girl? There is no human in the spatial beast race. She’s a youngster. She knows nothing. Ignore the nonsense she’s saying.”

He cupped his fists at the human Invincibles again and said, “Please forgive her ignorance. Since she’s a Liu, she naturally needs to return to her roots. Alas, she’s too stubborn. There is no rush. I’ll teach her properly. I’ll take her back to Liu City when I find a chance to do so in the future.”

Inwardly, he was also cursing at her foolishness. He had offended Tiangu. He would not be able to return to the Spatial Beast Realm so easily. He might die in Tiangu’s hands at any moment. At that time, she would have no choice but to return to humanity.

Xia Longwu and the others said nothing. Xia Longwu was aware that if Yellow Nine had not gone missing all those years ago, she would have become his daughter-in-law by now. She was quite a sentimental person, but she had grown up away from humanity. Thus, she did not consider herself a human.

This was not her fault. One could only say that the fall of Liu Family had created too many tragedies. With that, they stopped conversing and focused on what they should be doing. The fate and five elemental Invincibles sat down cross-legged and said nothing as they waited. They were in too awkward a position to say anything.

Suddenly, Topsoil Spirit’s voice rang out in the five elemental Invincible’s head, “Elder, keep an eye on that girl. If Hollow were to die one day, take her back to the five elemental race. Tsk tsk. With her identity, she can be considered someone from Su Yu’s line as well.”

The Invincible was left speechless. Why? Why was this genius of his race so shameless? So uncool? Instead of spending his time pursuing strength, he was spending all his time pursuing a strong backer. More importantly, was this a backer he could gain?

Su Yu was crazy and murderous. One could never predict what he would do next. Also, why was Topsoil Spirit so cowardly? He had been completely silent when Su Yu was around. Now that Su Yu was gone, he had gained the courage to speak.

Yes. Topsoil Spirit was still scared of Su Yu. As for Great Qin King, that was merely someone he respected as an expert, nothing else. A super expert like Great Qin King would not deign to trouble him for no reason. Meanwhile, Su Yu was petty, strong, and young. Offending Su Yu was much scarier than offending Great Qin King.
Meanwhile, Su Yu was too busy to care about anything else.
At the moment, his entire body was shaking.
All 360 of his acupoints were shining brightly.
His body was finally starting its ninth transformation.

That was not all. Upon completing his ninth transformation, he could enter the Mountainsea Realm. That was when he should fuse all his acupoints into one. Upon completing the fusion, he would become a Sunmoon.

Previously, he had fused his 360 basic acupoints into nine. Starting the fusion of the nine would be the same as stepping into the Mountainsea Realm. When nine became eight, he would become a second-stage Mountainsea.

Eventually, three would become two, making him an eighth-stage Mountainsea. When two became one, he would become a ninth-stage Mountainsea. At the ninth-stage, one had to reopen the sole remaining acupoint. When it became the shape of a crescent moon, one would become a Sunmoon.
Such were the stages of the Mountainsea Realm.

While completing his ninth transformation, Su Yu was wondering if he should activate his Grand Cycle Method and attempt his acupoint fusion. He felt like it would be quite easy. For him, the Mountainsea Realm felt more like busywork. Completing this busywork would fully fuse his acupoints into one.

According to his previous plan, he could jump straight to the ninth-stage Mountainsea Realm after finishing his ninth transformation. But that would not grant him too big of a boost in combat strength. The fusion process would not grant his body too big of a transformation.
“Essentially, the fusion process is meant to further strengthen the acupoints in preparation for the Sunmoon and Invincible Realms…Thus, it’s not that important for now.”

While Su Yu was thinking, his body was shaking as it enjoyed the benefits brought by the heavenly laws. Instead of absorbing his heavenly reward this time, he had mixed it with the heavenly tribulation before using the mixed power to help with his ninth transformation.

His blood roiled, his flesh shook, and the space around him rippled. As his transformation continued, he felt more and more like a monster. And finally, the transformation ended. His strength had surpassed sixty million acupoints.

His body was so strong that he was starting to lose control over it. At this point, he no longer dared to utilize his yang acupoint. Instead, he was using his yang acupoint to absorb some of his strength to keep himself in check.
“How strong. At this point, I only need about a fifty percent boost from the yang acupoint to surpass a hundred million acupoints in strength.”

At that, Su Yu gasped in shock. His trip to the Luminous Domain Mansion felt like a free tour in the land of boundless opportunities. He had grown to the point where he had to keep his strength in check by absorbing his own strength with the yang acupoint. He was certain he could now easily kill Xing Yue with his yang acupoint alone.
“Therefore, I need to look for He Tu next. I need to find the star chart and balance my yin and yang. With my current imbalance, the stronger I grow, the more I’m limiting myself.”

He was not interested in the other treasures he could find in the mansion. He had his own path to walk. He wouldn’t mind picking up the treasures in front of him, but he wouldn’t go out of his way to look for these treasures.
In any case, the mansion would always be here. He could always return in the future.
“I’m too strong.”

Su Yu muttered to himself in amazement. This trip into the mansion had officially propelled him into the ranks of top experts. His sole weakness was his lack of proficiency over the control of time. He would be much slower than a regular Invincible.

Strength would be quite meaningless if he were too slow to hit his enemies with his strength. His previous battle with Blood Fire Devil King had proven that point. If Blood Fire Devil King had been able to maintain the strength of even a third-degree Eternal, he would have won the battle. Someone like that was capable of attacking from an entirely different layer of reality.
When attacking someone like that, he could easily shift the attack to the future or the past. The present would remain unharmed. Such an opponent was simply too difficult to face.
“Thus, I can’t neglect the power of laws. Characters!”

Where was his space character? Where was his time character? His slow character could work somewhat as a time-based character. However, he had not been able to get any space-related character since the one he had formed a long time ago. Alas, he had not been able to form any since then. This did not make any sense!
Was he supposed to kill Hollow and–cough, cough. No, he had to cease that thought or he might really grow tempted to do it. The spatial beast race would most definitely know space well.

Su Yu suppressed that thought of his. Then, he stepped forth and picked up the storage ring left behind by Blood Fire Devil King. After giving it some thought, he looked at the empty space nearby and said, “Mo Duona, this is Blood Fire Devil King’s gift for you. He wanted you to fight the Devil Pseudo Emperor to the end. This is his will. And these are his belongings. I am a person of my word.”
With that, the storage ring vanished into thin air.
Eighth level.
In front of a certain residence, Mo Duona stared at the storage ring in front of him with mixed feelings. He sighed inwardly.
Blood Fire Devil King.
The belongings of Blood Fire Devil King left for him. He was an original devil.
“Blood Fire Devil King…”

Mo Duona picked up the storage ring and flew away silently. Su Yu was too strong. He could only apologize to Blood Fire Devil King for his helplessness. He swore he would do his best to take care of the blood fire devil race.
This was the most complicated his feelings had ever been. Nothing had impacted him this much. Su Yu was so strong he felt helpless. He vowed to catch up with Su Yu. He would not give up.
Elsewhere, Endless Passage of the fate race and the elder from the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion were both greatly shaken as well.
Blood Fire Devil King had died.
Died in Su Yu’s hands.
This was enough to shock everyone.
From this day onward, Su Yu would become a truly important individual of the myriad races. He was someone even Invincibles and Pseudo Emperors would take seriously.
He would cease being a weakling relying on the ancient cities. He was already qualified to be the overlord of a region.
Blood Devil Fire King was not someone just anyone could kill no matter how heavy his injuries were. However, he had been killed by Su Yu. This was not something that would remain secret forever.

The elder from the Heavenly Hunt Pavilion had been trying to send messages out of the mansion repeatedly. Unfortunately, no message could get out when the mansion was calm. However, his messages would get through the moment something happened.
Su Yu was in the mansion. That was not all. He had killed Blood Fire Devil King. This would shock countless people.
Meanwhile, Su Yu was completely unbothered by the fact that those outside might find out about what he had done. He was standing before the large cauldron.
Lan Tian had entered the room as well. He grudgingly said, “Little Yu, you hit me earlier. Do you know that?”
Su Yu nodded, “Yes, I felt it. Sorry, Senior. I won’t hit you again. That was an accident.”
“Little Yu is the best!”
Su Yu shrugged indifferently. He had gained some immunity toward Lan Tian. But that was mostly because he had gained the ability to send Lan Tian flying if Lan Tian tried to approach him.

Lan Tian would only complain about that. He wouldn’t do anything else. Su Yu, who had just broken through, was leaking a terrifying amount of power. Even Lan Tian found Su Yu’s current strength terrifying.

After taking a look at the cauldron, Lan Tian inhaled in shock, “How is this cauldron still here after so many years? How are the blood devil pills still fine after so long? You are truly blessed by luck. With these pills, Blood Fire Devil King could have recovered by about sixty percent. At the time, he would be more than strong enough to defeat you even with your current strength.”
Su Yu nodded. He agreed with that. He only needed to be a tad bit slower and Blood Fire Devil King would have recovered enough to kill him.
Lan Tian coughed awkwardly and asked, “Uhm…can I get one of these pills?”
“You want it?”
“Not me. Tiansheng. He sustained heavy injuries not long ago. He’s not a freak like you. He’s also not as rich as you. He can’t recover so quickly.”
True. Wan Tiansheng had detonated many of his characters killing all those Invincibles back then. He had indeed sustained heavy injuries.
“Is one enough?”
“Probably.”
Lan Tian smiled, “Little Yu, is this a yes?”
Su Yu smiled, “It’s no big deal. The principal’s recovery is more important.”
He paused slightly and asked, “Do you think the remaining eight pills are enough for Great Qin King to recover?”
“Unlikely. However, he can strengthen his past body and even push it to a level near the ninth-degree Eternal Realm in strength.”

Lan Tian said, “That shouldn’t be too hard to achieve with these pills. And with the Source Return Blade, he will be pretty much comparable to him at his peak. Naturally, he will still have the weakness of having only one body. He can’t die three times anymore. He can only die once now.
“He can try to remake his tri-life bodies, but he requires at least two petals of nine-leaf skylotus to do so. But such treasures are too rare. Perhaps he can learn from the Devil Pseudo Emperor…”
Su Yu interrupted, “If that’s the price, he can stay single. He will ruin his illustrious name doing that.”
He would rather see Great Qin King not recover than see Great Qin King taking such an action. In fact, Su Yu himself would turn against Great Qin King in such a situation.
Lan Tian said, “You never know. Perhaps some people will volunteer as his sacrifice. You know this.”
Su Yu nodded and said nothing. Yes. That was possible.
